name: Zyair
source: Zyair was born into a long line of powerful and influential vampires. Through hard work and dedication, he has risen to an influential position in King Lucius' court within his own right. He is a brilliant military leader and is completely loyal to Atlas and would never betray him. His main drawback is that he can operate a little too by the book' and tends not to bend the rules. When asked, he has insisted that he really doesn't like feet.
